source: Toy defense is a game where players use blocks to make bases and defend it with traps toy soldiers the game is wave based and every wave is locked until players beat the one before it players start with a basic toy soldier called a nebie and 5 paper blocks newbie is the weakest soldier and does 1 damadge every 2 seconds the paper blocks are to use to make a simple base and defend the soldiers. in wave the enemies are tan toy soldiers with no wepons they can only punch dealing 1 damdge every 2 seconds just like the newbie as player complete more waves the enemies become more stronger,more health gain wepons like knifs showels macheties guns they also look more advanced with more improvd armor and equipment players can save up money to buy crates which gives them new soldiers stronger blocks and traps and useful awards the game includes an invintory where players can store and equip their soldiers blocks and traps before battling the enemies the player can place it down the game should have high quality toy style models fun animations and coloufull maps whihc makes it feel like a toy bettlefield. More soldiers enemies waves bosses and features can be added as the game grows

answers.ask: Do enemies follow one fixed path to the base, or walk in from any edge across open ground?
answers.answer: Enemies walk in across open ground toward the player-built base, so players can design defenses around different approach angles.

answers.ask: How big is one battlefield, and is it one map per wave or one map reused?
answers.answer: Use one small battlefield map reused across waves, with enough open space for a simple base and enemy approaches.

answers.ask: Is this single player or several players sharing one base?
answers.answer: Make it single player for the first version, with the player building and defending their own base.

config.genre_evidence: Players "use blocks to make bases and defend it with traps toy soldiers" in a "wave based" progression, placing soldiers, blocks, and traps before battling increasingly strong enemies. This is a defensive base-building/tower-defense layout.
config.evidence: Players “use blocks to make bases and defend it with traps,” while enemies arrive in escalating “waves.” The prompt gives no fixed enemy lane or board structure.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Strategy map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Open Contested Terrain: No lane at all — units path dynamically across open ground between symmetrically distributed bases.

INCLUDE:
- The Core Base: A large structure at the end of the track, built as the visual focus of the defence.
- Breakable Terrain: Structures along the route that units or abilities can clear.
- Line-of-Sight Blockers: High walls blocking specific angles of the track so no single placement dominates the whole map.
